attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) to serve DHCP on lan-a (eth2, 10.50.10.0/24) and node2 (OPNsense) to serve DHCP on lan-b (vtnet2/opt1, 10.50.20.0/24), each handing out its own gateway address as the host's default route. node3 (behind node1) and node4 (behind node2) now obtain their addressing dynamically from the router in front of them instead of static configuration. All four nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory evidence protocol, with boot-identity change confirmed and full DHCP/routing recovery verified on each.
